title: Rabbo sinni badak haadiyya
intro: taswiir soolam baaxal caddok dagah quuki merraytih amol mooyat fayya iyyam kee markabeenit quuki sahhalossuh mangom qidda. Inki num fooca fan gexaah, ellecabo celtah tan sarrimaane oggolak, dubuk addah culma salat kee madaara arac takkuh. Dirab derret ayyunti yamaate digaalak takkaawiseh, foocal qammalsime wayta racmatta tan.
clues: Anu bool alfiik daga takke marah farmoyti akkuk ruubeh suge.
Anu inni ummatta gexuh idini geyak naharal naqabut cabe.
Anu quuki markabat koreh, taameynit markabak amot qiddam miyyi kinnim madqoonuh mangom qiden.
Anu baddi addat qideeh, kaxxa kullumti yoh yanxuqeeh, anu esserimeh suge wak.
Anu diteh addat Yalla fayliseeh, kaa akke waytek rabbi anewaam kee anu zaalmih marak sugem baxxaqisak.
Anu fakut yan baddi qaxih amol qideeh, biyaakiteh, Yalli yok amol qasbo caxa yeyyeeqeh, tokkel yi ummatta elle taamineeh, wakti fanah rufto keenih teceeh.

trial.label: Maqaynatih gibbatu yot garayeeh?
options: Girat qideenim xabca kee amaan le
Aysinu le toobokoyti adda xer qeeli addat qiden
Kicintoh tan awka fida kah takkennah amrisen

location.label: Yok Lafale Liyyitte Macaay?
options: weeqi leeh amol tan coox doonik

outcome.label: Yi Xali Maca Sugteeh?
options: assakat cattimtem kee yi ummatta elle taaminem kee waktih cattimte
Yi ummatta sabti yiggileenimih taagah damaaqe fan tendebbe
Yi ummatta kaxxiinak ardi yonxuqeh suge.
Yi ummatta qaraanak caylale bakaq tibbixe
outcome.answer: assakat cattimtem kee yi ummatta elle taaminem kee waktih cattimte

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more. (37:147)
